title: Decoding Research Trends: A Clustering Based Topic Modeling Framework
desc: Compared K-Means, hierarchical clustering and DBSCAN for unsupervised topic modeling on 10,000 arXiv "Artificial Intelligence" abstracts (TF-IDF + PCA), finding the AI literature skews toward societal issues such as ethics and security, and that no single method fits all: K-Means suits broad summaries while DBSCAN surfaces the core-periphery structure of emerging research. With A. P. Neteish and A. Salam.

title: Beyond NER: A Comparative Benchmark of Medical BERTS for Multi-Label Adverse Drug Reaction Classification
conference: International Conference on Intelligent Data Analysis and Applications (IDAA 2025)
desc: Benchmarked domain-specific Medical BERT models for multi-label adverse drug reaction classification demonstrating improved performance over general BERT on the PsyTAR dataset by fine-tuning BioBERT and PubMedBERT architectures with multi-label classification heads.

title: Cyclones and Calamity: A Historical and Statistical Unmasking of Losses in Bangladesh
desc: Presented a historical and statistical analysis of cyclone losses in Bangladesh to an international audience, by collecting, modeling, and visualizing climate data with statistical methods.
